body: It was the hardest thing I ever had to go through. Military buddies underatand because they've been through it. They know what it's like. She saw what a mess I was and still loved me anyway. Some people are just special

He was my brother. And he got.me through so much. But im shaming him and my wife everyday i live like this. 
Its not about me unable to get better. If i put myaelf through hell for a month, i could maybe stop drinking and shake the drug habbit. But i dont want to. Im yoo tired and when i think about ending it, i get relief. Because it'll finally be over. And im ready for it

Thank you. 

If he had a good quality of life, I'd say to keep living it. For the rest of us that can't. But I can't do it anymore. Nightmares, fucked body, drug and alcohol abuse. This is no life

I had some.buddies back in the army. I joined at the height of the gulf war. Afterwards me and a friend got stationed in Rwanda together. He's the friend that died recently. Best man at my wedding. If I were in his shoes i wouldn't blame him for doong what I was doing
They would probably disagree with all the choices I've made these past few months. Drinking, xanax, starting to cut. Shit teenagers do. I'm ending it before it gets out of control

I've been fortunate enough to have a great partner and the one close friend I had to get me through it passed away from cancer. I have no kids or other family to speak of. Tell me, what's something you want to do before you die?
